This ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENT AGREEMENT (at times referred to as the “Agreement"), made as of the 21_ day of July, 2025, by and between 1119 BOSTON ROAD-3737 WPR LLC,having anoffice at 4400Second Avenue,Brooklyn,NY 11232, (referred to herein as “Parcel A Owner"), and WHITE PLAINS 3743 LLC, having an office at 4400 Second Avenue,Brooklyn, NY 11232, (referred to herein as “Parcel B Owner"). Parcel A Owner and Parcel B Owner are sometimes hereinafter referred toindividually as a“Party” orcollectively asthe“Parties". WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Parcel A Owner is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon,in the Borough of Bronx and County of Bronx,City and State of New York, generally known as and by the street address 3737 White Plains Road, Bronx,NewYork, and designated as Tax Lot 71 inBlock 4651 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork,Bronx County (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein referred to as the“Parcel A Land,”" said buildings and improvements located thereon as of the date hereof, if any,and any future replacements or new buildings constructed thereon being herein referred to as the“Parcel A Building,”and the Parcel A Land and the Parcel A Building being herein collectively referred to as“Parcel A"); WHEREAS,Parcel B Owner is the owner of certain lands,with the buildings and improvements thereon,in the Borough of Bronx and County of Bronx, City and State of New York, generally known as and by the street address 3743 White Plains Road, Bronx, NewYork, and designated as Tax Lot 67 in Block 4651 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described on Exhibit “B” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (such land being herein collectively referred to as the“Parcel B Land,”said buildings and improvements located thereon as of the date hereof, if any, and any future replacements or new buildings constructed thereon being herein referred to as the“Parcel B Building,”and the Parcel B Land, the Parcel B Building being herein collectively referredtoas"ParcelB");
